name: Quotient AI
description: Quotient is an AI-native marketing platform that plans and runs campaigns across email, social, blog and events, with an audience CRM, flows and brand memory.

events.d: Create or update a person by email, with lists, events and custom properties.
Subscribe a person to marketing email, honoring double opt-in, with optional topics.
Create or update a company by domain; set name, industries, revenue, address, social links, and custom properties.
Enroll a person in a programmatic Quotient flow, with optional metadata.
Record a custom event for a known person. Set person, custom event, and optional campaign or idempotency key.
Create an audience list or update its name and description.
Add people to a selected audience list by email or person ID.
Remove people from a selected audience list by email or person ID.
Create or update a Quotient memory document with markdown, tags and pinning.
